interventions.claim_text: If you have humans cut back their salt considerably, they become insulin resistant.
interventions.intervention_text: Claims on salt reduction and insulin resistance are debated. Some studies show a possible link, but it's not conclusive.

interventions.claim_text: If you measure them a week later ... they will be significantly more insulin resistant.
interventions.intervention_text: Short-term impacts of salt reduction on insulin resistance have mixed evidence and are not consistently significant.

interventions.claim_text: The main contributor to high blood pressure is insulin resistance.
interventions.intervention_text: High blood pressure can have multiple contributing factors, including genetics, diet, and lifestyle, not solely insulin resistance.
